category_title: Children who resist teacher instructions and break classroom rules
scenario_title: Non-participation and wandering aimlessly during group activities
minimal_context: The student is expected to join a group activity in the kindergarten classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone, it is time for our group activity. Please sit in the circle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves the group area without permission and runs aimlessly, not participating in the class activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back and sit still for the activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains silent, showing an inability to sit still and difficulty with the directions.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to finish the activity with the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stays completely silent, barely engaging in the kindergarten activity, and continues to wander aimlessly.)
